meta.redesign: Smithy (iron and ember) direction: a new look for the same inventory; colour, type, shape and shadow values are new and do not mirror the code yet

color.note: Forge is the primary theme: a smithy at night, plates of gunmetal and brushed steel, lit by the gleam of polished metal. Ash is the daylight theme: cooled ash and pale iron with the same gleam, darkened until it reads as text. Every fill is opaque; the grain shows only on the ground. The gleam is the machine at work; ember, the palette's one warm colour, is work that has come out of the fire and waits for you.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground: gunmetal steel in Forge, cooled ash in Ash. The workshop floor behind every plate; it carries the grain and the corner falloff, nothing else. `fg` is 16.2:1 on it in Forge, 13.8:1 in Ash.

tokens.name: bg-deep
tokens.usage: The shadow at the ground's corners (the falloff) and the darkest wash behind the drawer and dialogs.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: A plate's fill: one step up from the ground in Forge (a plate of brushed steel), one step lighter in Ash. Cards, KPI tiles, table wrappers, the drawer, dialogs, the command bar, popovers, toasts. Opaque: the grain never shows through it. `fg` is 14.5:1 on it in Forge, 15.9:1 in Ash.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The brightening wash over a plate or the chrome: the active nav item, the active tab, hovered table rows, the command bar's active option, inline code. Always over an opaque fill. `fg` stays above 12:1 and `muted` above 5.1:1 under it on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: The anvil: the sidebar and the status bar, the darkest surface in Forge and the lightest in Ash, with a `line-strong` edge and `shadow-chrome`. `fg` is 16.7:1 on it in both themes.

tokens.name: sheen
tokens.usage: The hover tint: a faint silver wash over a hovered button, nav item or tab's own fill, with its border turning `gleam`. Every text token keeps 4.5:1 or more on panel + sheen (weakest `ember` 5.2:1 in Forge, 4.6:1 in Ash).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The seam between plates: card and dialog outlines, table rules, dividers, input borders, the stamp line's rules.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Soft rules: cell rules inside tables, the box around a tool call in the log, the hairline between fact rows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The hard edge: the chrome's edge, the focus ring, the selected plate's outline, a hovered card's outline. Solid, at least 5.1:1 on `bg`, `panel` and `chrome` in both themes, so the focus ring never fades.

tokens.name: edge-light
tokens.usage: The top bevel of a forged plate: an inset 1px highlight along the top edge (`shadow-bevel`). Never used as a border of its own.

tokens.name: edge-dark
tokens.usage: The bottom bevel of a forged plate: an inset 1px shadow along the bottom edge (`shadow-bevel`), and the hard edge under the status bar.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Text: titles, body, values, the active nav item. Clears 14:1 on `bg`, `panel` and `chrome` in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, refs, counts, inactive nav items. 8.4 / 7.5 / 8.8:1 on bg / panel / chrome in Forge; 5.9 / 6.8 / 7.1:1 in Ash; above 5.1:1 under `raised` and `sheen` everywhere.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Placeholders and the nameplate's keys only. It does not meet 4.5:1 (4.0:1 on `bg` in Forge, 3.0:1 in Ash) and is never used for text a person must read.

tokens.name: gleam
tokens.usage: The gleam of polished steel: the one accent. The primary button's fill, the active nav item's rule, the progress fill, the selected segment, the live dot, links, the agent dot, the `live` and `gleam` chips. A silver-blue, never white, and never a flat fill (see `--gleam-fill` in bundle.css): 10.9:1 on `bg` in Forge as text, 5.6:1 in Ash. Means: the machine is working.

tokens.name: gleam-hot
tokens.usage: The primary button on hover and the live dot's halo: the gleam caught by the light. Fill only; `on-gleam` stays its text.

tokens.name: gleam-deep
tokens.usage: The shadowed edge under a primary button (`shadow-primary`) and the bar under a pressed segment: steel turned away from the light.

tokens.name: on-gleam
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `gleam` or `gleam-hot` fill: 11.3:1 in Forge, 6.5:1 in Ash. Never literal white or black on the gleam.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Ember: the one warm colour on the palette. The work has come out of the fire and waits for a person's hand: the outline and left bar of a job waiting on you, the `YOU` chip, banners, the current stepper dot of a blocked or failed job, the settings rail's error dot. As text 7.0:1 on `bg` in Forge, 5.3:1 in Ash. Never decoration, never a fill under copy.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `ember` fill, where one is ever needed: 7.3:1 in Forge, 6.1:1 in Ash.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: A spark: something just changed. Unsaved dots, the drawer's new-row dots, the Thread tab's unread count, `::selection`. A fill under `on-spark` text; never a text colour in Ash.

tokens.name: on-spark
tokens.usage: Text on a `spark` fill: 12.7:1 in Forge, 11.2:1 in Ash.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success, as text in a chip or a dot: tempered green. 9.6:1 on `panel` in Forge, 5.6:1 in Ash. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Attention: a held budget, a permission prompt, a conflict. Yellow, so it is never mistaken for `gleam`. 10.5:1 on `panel` in Forge, 6.0:1 in Ash.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Failure: a failed check, an error line, a CHANGES verdict. Salmon in Forge, brick in Ash: it differs from `ok` in hue and never relies on red-against-green alone. 7.6:1 on `panel` in Forge, 5.9:1 in Ash.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: The neutral kind: a PR number, a bug kind, a subagent block. Slate, quieter and greyer than `gleam`, never a signal. 8.1:1 on `panel` in Forge, 6.2:1 in Ash.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The system's own name only, set uppercase: the cover and an about screen. Nowhere in the working UI.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per view, in the page header's nameplate. Sentence case.

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.sample: Sync the design system from GitHub
styles.usage: The drawer's and dialogs' titles; the brand name in the sidebar nameplate.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: A section inside a plate or dialog; a popover's title.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: Add a tracker adapter for Linear
styles.usage: Job cards and table rows: the title, at most two lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The spec proposes two PRs: the adapter and a status-sync change.
styles.usage: Reading text: reasons, notes, messages, option rows, banners, toasts.

styles.name: body-prose
styles.sample: Rendered markdown from the agents, with headings in the heading styles and code in mono.
styles.usage: Rendered markdown (spec.md, replies) through the escape-first md().

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timelines, KPI detail lines, thread headers, footnotes.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Sidebar nav items and settings rail tabs, set uppercase.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, segments and tabs, set uppercase. A verb, rarely two words.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, column headers, fact-grid keys, callouts, set uppercase in `muted`.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: The stamp line under a page title and the nameplate's cells, set uppercase: facts struck into the plate.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Ids, refs, branches, paths, commands and inline code: never uppercased.

styles.name: mono-log
styles.usage: The session log and tool call blocks.

styles.name: kpi-value
styles.usage: The one large number: KPI tiles, tabular numerals.

spacing.note: An 8px grid; every size here is the dashboard's real measurement.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: A chip's vertical inset; the gap between a dot and its ring.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a stepper cluster; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: A chip's horizontal inset; the gap between chips in a state row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The resting gap inside a plate: between a card's slots, between table cells vertically.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: A nav item's inset; the gap between a nav icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: A dense card's padding; a button's and a table cell's horizontal inset; the board's column gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: A standard plate's padding; the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The drawer's padding on phones; between drawer sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The drawer's padding at md and up; the dialog's body inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The main column's gutter at md and up.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The empty state's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: The phone touch target: nav strip items, status bar indicators below md.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The layout major: column and sidebar widths are multiples of it.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: An icon in navigation and chips; 15px inside buttons.

tokens.name: size-mark
tokens.usage: The anvil mark in the sidebar's nameplate; 40px in the empty state.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: The sidebar column at md and up: brand plate, stamp line, repo, the command input, the nav and Settings.

tokens.name: size-settings-rail
tokens.usage: The settings dialog's rail of tabs.

tokens.name: size-board-column
tokens.usage: The minimum width of a board column.

tokens.name: size-content-max
tokens.usage: The main column's cap.

tokens.name: size-drawer-max
tokens.usage: The job drawer's width at md and up.

tokens.name: size-dialog
tokens.usage: The settings dialog's width; the command bar is 672px.

tokens.name: size-statusbar
tokens.usage: The status bar's height, plus the safe-area inset: one slim row of indicators and facts.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: A chip's minimum height.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: A small button, input or chip-sized control.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: The standard button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: A tab's height.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: The icon stroke: 1.5px, round caps and joins, a machined line: precise and even, never thickened.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.

tokens.name: bar-rule
tokens.usage: The gleam rule on the active nav item and the command bar's active row; the ember bar on a job waiting on you.

radius.note: Forged iron is cut, not rounded: every radius here is a straight chisel cut (`corner-shape: bevel`) at two opposite corners; a browser without corner-shape shows a soft corner of the same size. Dots stay round.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The chrome, the drawer and dialogs, table cells: uncut edges.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: The small chamfer on a plate's two uncut corners, so no corner is dead square.

tokens.name: radius-nick
tokens.usage: The nick: the cut on buttons, chips, inputs, nav items and checkboxes, at two opposite corners (top-left and bottom-right on buttons and chips; top-right and bottom-left on inputs and nav items). A segment strip keeps only its outer nicks.

tokens.name: radius-cut
tokens.usage: The cut: the larger chisel cut on a plate's top-left and bottom-right corners (cards, KPI tiles, the nameplate, code blocks). Overlays keep it; the drawer and the chrome have none.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Dots only: the stepper, the live dot, status dots, radios.

shadow.note: Plates carry an inset bevel; overlays cast a real shadow under the workshop light; heat glows. Nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-bevel
tokens.usage: The forged bevel on every plate: a 1px highlight along the top edge and a 1px shadow along the bottom, inside the outline. Cards, KPI tiles, the nameplate, inputs, the progress track.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: The shadowed edge under a primary button: a solid 2px `gleam-deep` lip. Pressing drops the button onto it (translate 2px, no shadow).

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the command bar, popovers and toasts: a plate lifted off the bench under the workshop light.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The job drawer's shadow over the page to its left.

tokens.name: shadow-chrome
tokens.usage: The sidebar's shadow over the main column, so the anvil sits above the floor.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The glint: the progress fill, the live dot and the primary button on hover shine. Nothing else glows.
